note: Each folder under docs/ is one app site. Set published to false to hide that app from the studio homepage.

apps.name: BittyPals
apps.description: A pixel cat companion. Feed, play, clean up, and let them sleep so happiness stays high.

apps.name: Drawise
apps.description: Trace the red lines and learn to draw cute animals, one easy step at a time.

apps.name: FixVerdict
apps.description: Photograph a home issue and get a DIY, call-a-pro, or emergency verdict.

apps.name: Goodoku
apps.description: A cozy logic puzzle. Place one goo in every row, column, and color, and keep them from touching.

apps.name: Goo Patrol
apps.description: A kid-friendly landscape shooter. Pop goo, tidy four worlds, and dash out of trouble.

apps.name: HabitGreen
apps.description: Every habit becomes a GitHub-style grid. One square a day, one tap to fill it.

apps.name: LastChair
apps.description: Record every ski and snowboard run — route, speed, vertical, and slope — privately on your phone.

apps.name: PowderLog
apps.description: Record a ski or snowboard day and come back to a map of runs, speed, vertical, and slope.

apps.name: StopMotionPop
apps.description: Make stop-motion movies in minutes. No account, and frames stay on the device until you share them.

apps.name: Tripolony
apps.description: Watch a ski route before you go. Video-led trip reports, starting at Snoqualmie Pass.
